description: Aggregates of the November 2026 real world trial: testwitness 0.1.0 run commit to commit on the 15 most recent merged pull requests that touch tests in each of 20 popular open source repositories, every medium and high finding judged by hand against the diff. Per rule counts only; no repository, person or pull request is named. The hook grading is computed from these judged findings (a working tree check gives the same findings as the commit check), not from a rerun of the hook. The severities are what each rule said before the v0.1 cap on unproven rules (packages/core/src/proven.ts). pullRequestsAtDefault grades with the current default: the blocking list A002, R003, R004, R005 and W006, at medium, except A002 at high. pullRequestsFailOnMedium grades the same list with A002 also blocking at medium. The trial was first graded with an older list (A002, R004, R005, W002, W003, W006) at high; of the rules the two lists do not share, none has a medium or high finding in the trial, and R003, R004, R005 and W006 have none either, so lowering the threshold to medium changes only A002, and only when it blocks at medium.
